semantic_contract.cost_semantics: catalog costs are declarative; current cost-bearing runtime supports treasury only and remains payment authority
semantic_contract.duration_semantics: duration_months is declarative; the current runtime does not use this catalog to schedule expiration
semantic_contract.effect_semantics: effects use only keys supported by GovernmentPolicyEffectSystem and preserve its 0_to_1 range validation
semantic_contract.provenance_semantics: definition_metadata_not_runtime_state; authored values are simulation calibration, not historical country observations
semantic_contract.spending_allocation_bundle_semantics: any policy changing government spending shares must include all four supported shares and sum to exactly 1.0 to preserve GovernmentSpendingAllocationSystem invariants
semantic_contract.effect_ownership_semantics: each supported effect key has one catalog policy owner; the spending bundle owns all four spending-share keys together
semantic_contract.content_scope_semantics: three bounded MVP policy definitions covering the existing six supported policy effects; runtime catalog binding is deferred

revenue_mobilization.name: Revenue Mobilization
revenue_mobilization.description: A calibrated increase in the existing tax-revenue rate, representing a policy choice to strengthen recurring public revenue.

provenance.notes: The 0.15 target, treasury cost, and duration are balancing values selected for the MVP catalog, not a historical tax rate or real fiscal cost.

investment_stimulation.name: Investment Stimulation
investment_stimulation.description: A calibrated increase in the existing investment-rate parameter intended to favor investment within the current economic model.

provenance.notes: The 0.20 target, treasury cost, and duration are balancing values selected for the MVP catalog, not a historical investment rate or real fiscal cost.

infrastructure_priority.name: Infrastructure Priority
infrastructure_priority.description: A bundled reallocation of government spending toward infrastructure while preserving the four-category allocation total.

provenance.notes: The shares sum to 1.0: infrastructure 0.35, military 0.20, public services 0.30, administration 0.15. Values and treasury cost are simulation-balancing choices, not historical budget data.
